title: The Miner' Wife ... Takes Her Pick
writer: Hans-Henning Claer, Franz Marischka, Gunter Otto
actors: Michel Jacot, Anne Graf, Gunter Wallace
plot: Heiner works in a mine, drinks beer, and goes to bed with other women, except from his wife, because of his baby son and the neighbours downstairs. But she does not feel like giving up all the fun for so long.
